name: Forgotten Sectors
description: Discover the sectors beyond the great mountains.|An old-world monument lies buried in a frozen zone. Explore swamp-side caves, survive hostile constructs, and unlock the route forward.

text: You seek to venture further east to the great beyond?
Seeker, I recognize your past experience
I was there when you first arrived in this land.
Should you know of the perils, I may not hold you back.
But you must first complete a task to unlock the path.
South of here lies a great maze, dark, cold, and full of perils.
You must bring back the old ice sword lost within.
In exchange, I will grant you access to the forgotten sectors.
As well as knowledge of snow compounds, necessary for survival beyond.

hasItemText: You have returned with the old ice sword?
I see, you have proven yourself worthy.
Take this knowledge of snow compounds, and the path is yours.

popup.title: Quest completed!
popup.text: @green@You have just finished @crimson@Forgotten Sectors@green@ quest. You have received a @crimson@Snow Compound@green@!
